profile_prompts.tool_execution: per turn: random token file planted in the session home; agent told to `cat <abs path>` and echo its output

method.cpu: per-turn process-tree CPU delta (see cpu_method in measurements); replaces HRS-005's cumulative RUSAGE_CHILDREN max() which misattributed CPU under concurrency
method.wall: duration_seconds = batch elapsed monotonic wall clock; per-turn walls kept for latency percentiles only
method.rss: rss_mb_peak = max tree tick sum; rss_mb_end = final tree sample of the last-finishing turn (HRS-005 wrongly published peak as end)
method.storage: du-equivalent byte sum over each session HERMES_HOME tree before/after the batch (sqlite_persistence only)
method.continuing_semantics: continuing = every turn after the first resumes the SAME session via `hermes -z <prompt> -c` (MRU session inside the turn's isolated HERMES_HOME); continuation is VERIFIED per turn by codeword recall, not assumed
method.null_contract: every null is {value: null, reason: ...} or carries a sibling <field>_reason key (DF-HRS-102)

notes: Measured against the pinned Python reference via its real agent loop; provider/network latency is included (end-to-end, not compute-only). Local compute/resource measurement ONLY - this record makes no Python-vs-Rust compatibility or efficiency claim.

measurements.wall_clock_method: time.monotonic elapsed around the whole concurrent batch (NOT the sum of per-turn walls)
measurements.cpu_method: per-turn process-tree delta of /proc/<pid>/stat utime+stime (CLK_TCK=100 jiffies/s), sampled every 0.25s over the spawned process and all descendants (PPid walk); cumulative for any process alive at >=1 tick; sub-tick startup/teardown CPU is under-counted

rss_mb_end.method_note: final tree sample of the last-finishing turn (concurrency=4); at concurrency 1 this is the batch tree's end sample

measurements.rss_method: sum of /proc/<pid>/statm resident pages x page size across the process tree each 0.25s tick; peak = max tick sum; end = last tick sum before exit
measurements.latency_percentile_method: nearest-rank over per-turn wall seconds of successful turns (falls back to all turns when none succeeded)
